fact: Diploma Ministerial 119/2022 of 24 November 2022 charges INAM's Quality Management Unit with publicising the ISO quality certification seal awarded to INAM, IP.
title: Diploma Ministerial n.º 119/2022: Aprova o Regulamento Interno do Instituto Nacional de Meteorologia, Instituto Público
